mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sq_artifact (artifact_id, user_id, file_name, media_type, size_bytes, sha256, upload_key, content_bytes, expires_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{name}, #{mediaType}, #{size}, #{hash}, #{key}, #{content}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT artifact_id, user_id, file_name, media_type, size_bytes, sha256, upload_key, NULL AS content, expires_at FROM sq_artifact WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND artifact_id = #{id} AND del_flag = '0' AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sq_task_artifact r JOIN sq_goal_task t ON t.user_id = r.user_id AND t.task_id = r.task_id JOIN sq_conversation c ON c.user_id = t.user_id AND c.conversation_id = t.conversation_id WHERE r.user_id = sq_artifact.user_id AND r.artifact_id = sq_artifact.artifact_id AND (c.status <> 'ACTIVE' OR c.del_flag <> '0' OR t.del_flag <> '0')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sq_scope_artifact r JOIN sq_execution_scope s ON s.user_id = r.user_id AND s.scope_id = r.scope_id JOIN sq_conversation c ON c.user_id = s.user_id AND c.conversation_id = s.conversation_id WHERE r.user_id = sq_artifact.user_id AND r.artifact_id = sq_artifact.artifact_id AND (c.status <> 'ACTIVE' OR c.generation <> s.conversation_generation OR c.del_flag <> '0' OR r.del_flag <> '0' OR s.del_flag <> '0' OR (s.kind = 'TASK' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sq_goal_task t WHERE t.user_id = s.user_id AND t.task_id = s.owner_id AND t.scope_id = s.scope_id AND t.del_flag = '0')) OR (s.kind = 'RESPONSE' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sq_response_execution e WHERE e.user_id = s.user_id AND e.execution_id = s.owner_id AND e.scope_id = s.scope_id AND e.del_flag = '0')))) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sq_message_artifact r JOIN sq_message m ON m.user_id = r.user_id AND m.message_id = r.message_id JOIN sq_conversation c ON c.user_id = m.user_id AND c.conversation_id = m.conversation_id WHERE r.user_id = sq_artifact.user_id AND r.artifact_id = sq_artifact.artifact_id AND (c.status <> 'ACTIVE' OR c.del_flag <> '0' OR m.del_flag <> '0'))
